# `<sl-switch>` — Switch

Switches allow the user to toggle an option on or off.

**Status:** stable · **Since:** 2.0

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/switch/switch.js';`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | — | `string` | `''` | — |
| `name` | — | `string` | `''` | The name of the switch, submitted as a name/value pair with form data. |
| `value` | — | `string` | — | The current value of the switch, submitted as a name/value pair with form data. |
| `size` | — | `small`, `medium`, `large` | `'medium'` | The switch's size. |
| `disabled` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the switch. |
| `checked` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Draws the switch in a checked state. |
| `form` | — | `string` | `''` | By default, form controls are associated with the nearest containing `<form>` element. This attribute allows you to place the form control outside of a form and associate it with the form that has this `id`. The form must be in the same document or shadow root for this to work. |
| `required` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Makes the switch a required field. |
| `help-text` | `helpText` | `string` | `''` | The switch's help text. If you need to display HTML, use the `help-text` slot instead. |

## Properties without an attribute

These can only be set from JavaScript: `element.prop = value`, `[prop]="value"` in Angular, `.prop=${value}` in Lit. Writing them as HTML attributes does nothing.

| Property | Type | Notes | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` |  | The default value of the form control. Primarily used for resetting the form control. |
| `validity` | — | read-only | Gets the validity state object |
| `validationMessage` | — | read-only | Gets the validation message |

## Events

Listen with `addEventListener`, `(event-name)` in Angular or `@event-name` in Lit. Data is on `event.detail`.

| Event | `event.detail` | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sl-blur` | — | Emitted when the control loses focus. |
| `sl-change` | — | Emitted when the control's checked state changes. |
| `sl-input` | — | Emitted when the control receives input. |
| `sl-focus` | — | Emitted when the control gains focus. |
| `sl-invalid` | — | Emitted when the form control has been checked for validity and its constraints aren't satisfied. |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `click()` | Simulates a click on the switch. |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions)` | Sets focus on the switch. |
| `blur()` | Removes focus from the switch. |
| `checkValidity()` | Checks for validity but does not show a validation message. Returns `true` when valid and `false` when invalid. |
| `getForm()` | Gets the associated form, if one exists. |
| `reportValidity()` | Checks for validity and shows the browser's validation message if the control is invalid. |
| `setCustomValidity(message: string)` | Sets a custom validation message. Pass an empty string to restore validity. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The switch's label. |
| `help-text` | Text that describes how to use the switch. Alternatively, you can use the `help-text` attribute. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |
| `control` | The control that houses the switch's thumb. |
| `thumb` | The switch's thumb. |
| `label` | The switch's label. |
| `form-control-help-text` | The help text's wrapper. |

## CSS custom properties

| Property | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--width` | — | The width of the switch. |
| `--height` | — | The height of the switch. |
| `--thumb-size` | — | The size of the thumb. |

## Documentation and examples

```html
<sl-switch>Switch</sl-switch>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/switch/switch.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-switch-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `<sl-switch>Switch</sl-switch>`
})
export class SwitchExampleComponent {}
```

> **Tip:** This component works with standard `<form>` elements. Please refer to the section on form controls to learn more about form submission and client-side validation.
## Examples

### Checked

Use the `checked` attribute to activate the switch.

```html
<sl-switch checked>Checked</sl-switch>
```

### Disabled

Use the `disabled` attribute to disable the switch.

```html
<sl-switch disabled>Disabled</sl-switch>
```

### Sizes

Use the `size` attribute to change a switch's size.

```html
<sl-switch size="small">Small</sl-switch>
<br />
<sl-switch size="medium">Medium</sl-switch>
<br />
<sl-switch size="large">Large</sl-switch>
```

### Help Text

Add descriptive help text to a switch with the `help-text` attribute. For help texts that contain HTML, use the `help-text` slot instead.

```html
<sl-switch help-text="What should the user know about the switch?">Label</sl-switch>
```

### Custom Styles

Use the available custom properties to change how the switch is styled.

```html
<sl-switch style="--width: 80px; --height: 40px; --thumb-size: 36px;">Really big</sl-switch>
```
